messages.text:
Hello,

I am very disappointed with the support from Helium Deploy. I have been waiting for a few days for a return label, and you are not wanting to ship out what I have bought.

I have also bought Magic M. 40T and Harlo B30 awaiting shipment.

With this kind of support, I will need to evaluate any other future purchase from Helium Deploy.

kevin
Handed to the team · return_order.py create blocked: rma-approved tag missing, label cannot be purcha

Hi Kevin,

You are right to be annoyed, and the delay on the label is on us, not on you. We sent you a DC08 instead of the Thor P2 you paid for, and you have been waiting since that came to light.

Here is exactly where it sits. The return is under the reference Shop····, going back to our Chattanooga warehouse, and the shipping is on us. The one thing standing in the way is the internal sign off on the return, which I cannot do myself. I have put it in front of the team now and a colleague is picking it up today. The label comes to you in this thread, and nothing changes on your side: tape it to the box with the DC08 inside, write Shop···· on the outside, drop it at any UPS point. Your Thor P2 is reserved at Chattanooga and goes out once the DC08 is on its way back, with tracking emailed to you.

On your other two, your Harlo B30 on order Shop···· ships November 14, and it comes with the Power K.. For the Magic M. 40T, all units are built and Magic M. expects them to ship out from the factory on November 12, with your tracking emailed the moment yours leaves for you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Do you have the tracking number?

The DC08 is on the way back.

kevin
Handed to the team · release_paid_hold.py returned released false, problems: still held after release

Hi Kevin,

Thanks for getting the DC08 on its way back. I can see it moving: the return is logged as Shop···· and the UPS tracking on that box is (number hidden), going to our Chattanooga warehouse.

On your Thor P2, I do not have a tracking number for you yet. The replacement is raised at Chattanooga with your unit reserved on it, but the warehouse has not printed the label yet, so there is nothing real I can give you tonight and I would rather tell you that than send you a number that does not move. I have put it in front of the team to get it out the door, and they pick it up at 10am Eastern tomorrow morning. The tracking comes to you by email the moment the box leaves Chattanooga, and I will put it in this thread as well.

Nothing further is needed from you in the meantime.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
